_comment: PagerDuty has no native P0/P1/P2 concept; the rubric's incident_history criterion maps those severities onto PagerDuty's urgency field instead: urgency=high corresponds to a P0/P1-equivalent incident, urgency=low corresponds to a P2-equivalent incident.
